Catalan

[edit]

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): (Central) [pɾu.tə.ɣuˈnis.tə]
  • IPA(key): (Balearic) [pɾo.tə.ɣuˈnis.tə]
  • IPA(key): (Valencia) [pɾo.ta.ɣoˈnis.ta]
  • Audio (Barcelona):(file)

Noun

[edit]

protagonista m or f by sense (plural protagonistes)

  1. protagonist
    Antonym: antagonista

Derived terms

[edit]
  • protagonitzar

Related terms

[edit]
  • protagonisme

Czech

[edit]

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): [ˈprotaɡonɪsta]

Noun

[edit]

protagonista m anim

  1. protagonist (main character in a work)

Declension

[edit]
Declension of protagonista (masculine animate in -a)
singular plural
nominative protagonista protagonisté, protagonisti
genitive protagonisty protagonistů
dative protagonistovi protagonistům
accusative protagonistu protagonisty
vocative protagonisto protagonisté, protagonisti

Italian

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From Ancient Greek πρωταγωνιστής (prōtagōnistḗs).

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /pro.ta.ɡoˈnis.ta/
  • Rhymes: -ista
  • Hyphenation: pro‧ta‧go‧nì‧sta
  • Audio:(file)

Noun

[edit]

protagonista m or f by sense (masculine plural protagonisti, feminine plural protagoniste)

  1. protagonist
    Antonym: antagonista

Coordinate terms

[edit]
  • deuteragonista
  • tritagonista

Further reading

[edit]
  • protagonista in Treccani.it – Vocabolario Treccani on line, Istituto dell'Enciclopedia Italiana

Polish

[edit]
Polish Wikipedia has an article on:
protagonista (teatr)
Wikipedia pl

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from French protagoniste, from Ancient Greek πρωταγωνιστής (prōtagōnistḗs).

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /prɔ.ta.ɡɔˈɲis.ta/
  • Audio:(file)
  • Rhymes: -ista
  • Syllabification: pro‧ta‧go‧nis‧ta

Noun

[edit]

protagonista m pers (female equivalent protagonistka)

  1. (film, literature, theater) protagonist (main character)
    Antonym: antagonista
  2. protagonist (leading person in a contest)

Declension

[edit]
Declension of protagonista
singular plural
nominative protagonista protagoniści/protagonisty (deprecative)
genitive protagonisty protagonistów
dative protagoniście protagonistom
accusative protagonistę protagonistów
instrumental protagonistą protagonistami
locative protagoniście protagonistach
vocative protagonisto protagoniści

Further reading

[edit]
  • protagonista in Polish dictionaries at PWN

protagonista
Wikipedia pt

Etymology

[edit]

    Borrowed from French protagoniste.

    Pronunciation

    [edit]
     
    • (Brazil) IPA(key): /pɾo.ta.ɡoˈnis.tɐ/
    • (Brazil) IPA(key): /pɾo.ta.ɡoˈnis.tɐ/
      • (Rio de Janeiro) IPA(key): /pɾo.ta.ɡoˈniʃ.tɐ/
      • (Southern Brazil) IPA(key): /pɾo.ta.ɡoˈnis.ta/
    • (Portugal) IPA(key): /pɾu.tɐ.ɡuˈniʃ.tɐ/ [pɾu.tɐ.ɣuˈniʃ.tɐ]

    • Rhymes: -istɐ, -iʃtɐ
    • Hyphenation: pro‧ta‧go‧nis‧ta

    Noun

    [edit]

    protagonista m or f by sense (plural protagonistas)

    1. protagonist (main character)
    2. protagonist (leading person in a contest)

    • protagonizar
